title.ja: おいピジャン、どうしたの？

transcript.text: ซาสปีดมาๆเคชึบๆมาอ ปับสิ  5  6  7  8 ห้ามจะขยับให้จดี

translations.en: So speed come on, quick, hurry up. Bam, 5, 6, 7, 8, don't move, stay still.

translations.zh-TW: 速速來～快點快點來～ 5 6 7 8 不準動，給我站好！
translations.id: Cepat, ayo cepat, jangan bergerak, tetap di posisi 5, 6, 7, 8, jangan bergerak sampai bagus.
translations.pt: Vai, Speed, anda logo, rapidinho, pra lá. 5, 6, 7, 8, não se mexe, fica bem quieto.

translations.en: Oh good, nice. What's wrong? Hey Phi Chong, Phi Chong, hey, calling so often, oh hey.

translations.zh-TW: 嗯不錯不錯，怎麼了勒？ 欸～宗哥！宗哥欸，一直叫，噢欸！
translations.id: Bagus, ya bagus. Ada apa sih? Hei, Kak Jong, Kak Jong, kenapa dipanggil terus, oh hei!
translations.pt: Ah, legal, legal. O que foi, mano? Ei, mano Jong, mano Jong, caramba, chamando toda hora, caramba.
